# Børne-Unge Psyk. Klinik 40.K

Børne-Unge Psyk. Klinik 40.K is a clinical unit named in the Danish ADHD quality database report for the period 1 April 2024 – 31 March 2025 [^src1][^src2]. It appears in the report's tables measuring **Indikator 10**, a newly introduced quality indicator tracking whether adult patients' social support needs were assessed within 120 days of treatment start [^src1].

The clinic's recorded performance on this indicator was notably poor: it achieved **0% fulfillment**, based on a very limited data basis of only 0 out of 15 eligible treatment courses ("Nej 0 / 15 0 (0-22)") [^src1]. This places the clinic well below both the national fulfillment rate of 37% and the regional range of 14–52% reported for Indikator 10 across Denmark [^src1]. The clinic is also listed with a separate figure of "9" in a later appendix table detailing case numbers [^src2].

Indikator 10 was reported for the first time in this ADHD database cycle, and the overall national and regional shortfalls prompted the database's steering group to discuss underlying causes — including registration practices and data quality issues at child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals — and to commit to improving registration practices going forward [^src1]. Børne-Unge Psyk. Klinik 40.K's near-total lack of qualifying data (0/15) is consistent with this broader pattern of registration shortfalls flagged by the steering group [^src1].

No relationships or additional claims beyond these two data points are available in the source material. This is a sparse entry: the clinic is documented only through these two table mentions, with no narrative detail on its location, leadership, or organizational affiliation provided in the corpus.
